C. elegans Reproduction Analysis

2026-04-09

Setup

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ThemePark)

Data

set.seed(42)

n_per_cell <- 6

params <- tribble(
  ~strain,          ~diet,   ~mu,   ~size,
  "empty_vector",   "AL",    285,   18,
  "empty_vector",   "EODF",  195,   15,
  "daf",            "AL",    225,   14,
  "daf",            "EODF",  185,   12
)

block_effects <- tibble(
  block = 1:5,
  block_offset = c(0.05, -0.08, 0.12, -0.04, -0.05)
)

celegans_repro <- params |>
  crossing(block = 1:5) |>
  left_join(block_effects, by = "block") |>
  mutate(mu_adj = mu * exp(block_offset)) |>
  uncount(n_per_cell) |>
  mutate(
    worm_id         = row_number(),
    block           = factor(block),
    strain          = factor(strain, levels = c("empty_vector", "daf")),
    diet            = factor(diet,   levels = c("AL", "EODF")),
    total_offspring = rnbinom(n(), mu = mu_adj, size = size)
  ) |>
  select(worm_id, block, strain, diet, total_offspring) |>
  arrange(block, strain, diet)

Descriptive summary

celegans_repro |>
  group_by(strain, diet) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(total_offspring), 1),
    sd   = round(sd(total_offspring), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
## # A tibble: 4 × 5
##   strain       diet      n  mean    sd
##   <fct>        <fct> <int> <dbl> <dbl>
## 1 empty_vector AL       30  294.  82.9
## 2 empty_vector EODF     30  181.  48  
## 3 daf          AL       30  229.  64.9
## 4 daf          EODF     30  179.  47.9

Models

We fit a generalised linear mixed model with a negative binomial response (appropriate for overdispersed counts), a strain * diet interaction, and block as a random intercept.

m_full <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ strain * diet + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)

m_additive <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ strain + diet + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)

m_null <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ 1 + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)

Model comparison

AIC(m_null, m_additive, m_full)
##            df      AIC
## m_null      3 1371.693
## m_additive  5 1322.659
## m_full      6 1318.381
anova(m_additive, m_full)
## Data: celegans_repro

Post-hoc contrasts

emmeans(m_full, pairwise ~ strain * diet, type = "response")
## $emmeans
##  strain       diet response   SE  df asymp.LCL asymp.UCL
##  empty_vector AL        293 17.4 Inf       261       329
##  daf          AL        228 13.6 Inf       203       256
##  empty_vector EODF      180 10.8 Inf       160       202
##  daf          EODF      178 10.7 Inf       158       200
## 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## Intervals are back-transformed from the log scale 
## 
## $contrasts
##  contrast                            ratio     SE  df null z.ratio p.value
##  empty_vector AL / daf AL             1.28 0.0853 Inf    1   3.772  0.0009
##  empty_vector AL / empty_vector EODF  1.63 0.1090 Inf    1   7.322 <0.0001
##  empty_vector AL / daf EODF           1.65 0.1100 Inf    1   7.476 <0.0001
##  daf AL / empty_vector EODF           1.27 0.0849 Inf    1   3.554  0.0022

## 
## P value adjustment: tukey method for comparing a family of 4 estimates
